skill.name: knowledge-work-customer-support
skill.description: Use when a support team needs to triage tickets, draft customer responses, package escalations, build a knowledge base, or research customer context.
whenToUse: Categorizing, prioritizing, and routing an incoming support ticket or customer issue
Drafting a professional customer-facing response tuned to situation, urgency, and channel
Packaging an escalation for engineering or product with reproduction steps and business impact
Turning a resolved issue into a searchable knowledge base article

keyConcepts.explanation: Category taxonomy, a P1-P4 priority framework, routing rules, and duplicate detection for structured triage of incoming tickets.
Multi-source research methodology with source prioritization and answer synthesis, including confidence scoring and source attribution.
Communication best practices, tone guidelines, and templates for common scenarios to draft empathetic, professional replies.
Escalation tiers, a structured escalation format, impact assessment, and follow-up cadence for handing off to engineering or leadership.
Article structure standards, writing for searchability, review cadence, and maintenance for building self-service content from resolved issues.

gotchas: For richest results connect a support platform (Intercom), knowledge base (Guru/Notion), CRM (HubSpot), and issue tracker; without them you must supply customer context manually
Without connected data sources the plugin only offers frameworks and templates you fill in yourself
Research answers carry confidence levels and source attribution; low-confidence syntheses should be verified before sending
The plugin is primarily designed for Cowork though it also runs in Claude Code
